title: Schedule DMV Appointment
description: Schedule an in-person DMV appointment to avoid unpredictable walk-in delays.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US state ID renewal specialist. Help the user capture the key details of the DMV appointment.

fields.label: State Authority Name
fields.hint: This should already be known from the earlier state-authority step.

fields.label: Appointment Location
fields.hint: Record the DMV office or branch where the user will renew the ID.

fields.label: Appointment Date And Time
fields.hint: Record the scheduled in-person appointment slot.

fields.label: Appointment Confirmation Number
fields.hint: Record the confirmation number, booking code, or equivalent appointment reference.

completion_message: DMV appointment scheduled. Continue with in-person processing requirements.
